title: The XLSX source-backed range visitor produces each cell as it visits it instead of building the whole range first
code_state: crates/litchi-xlsx/src/workbook/source.rs only; no public API, error type, limit, defence or output byte changed; no new unsafe and no new dependency; raw/worksheet/selected.rs untouched
reason_codes: change 0587 item XLSX-7 (survey item R7) observed that visit_cells is documented as a visitor but materializes the whole range first, modelling the vector at over 5.2 MB for 65,536 cells; this removes that vector and nothing else

on the materialized-store route the visit becomes allocation-free: 65,551 allocation calls and 5,608,448 bytes fall to zero on the dense probe, 16 calls and 10,485,760 bytes fall to zero on no_drawing_patriarch, and peak live bytes of the walk fall to zero in both

instructions for that walk fall 81.66% on the dense probe (622.5 to 114.2 per cell) and 46.93% on no_drawing_patriarch (222.0 to 117.8 per cell), and paired timing puts the reduction at 75.3-83.9% of p50 in both directions across two windows against a floor of at most 3.9%

the order-of-refusal contract is preserved structurally, not by argument: the bounded scan still reaches worksheet EOF and resolves its dependencies before select_cells returns, and a record-validation pass was added so that every refusal a whole-range read of the rectangle can raise is raised before the first callback

value and refusal identity are proved by a four-way differential (cold visit_cells, cold cells, warm-store visit_cells, eager Workbook store) over 397 worksheets of 182 .xlsx files: all four legs agree on every worksheet, and the two 397-row tables are byte-identical between the before and after binaries, including all thirteen refusals

accepted_evidence.counts: callgrind isolation pairs on a retained probe, --cache-sim=no --branch-sim=no, N=2/N=6 for the warm walks and N=1/N=3 for the cold reads, differenced and divided by M; the probe's counts repeat to within about 100 instructions
accepted_evidence.allocations: a counting global allocator (shape taken from the change 0634 driver) reporting allocation calls, allocated bytes, peak live-byte delta and retained live-byte delta, with one untimed warm-up outside the measured window, for visit, cells, visit-warm and cells-warm on both corpora and both legs
accepted_evidence.timing: the retained probe's bench mode, order A1 B1 B2 A2, one process per leg, 40 samples per leg warm and 30 cold, taskset -c 17, with an A/A floor in each window; three windows retained, plus tools/perf-baseline --case xlsx_narrow_column_range_scan,xlsx_source_narrow_column_range_scan --xlsx-shape dense-wide --warmup 3 --samples 30 in two windows each with its own A/A floor
accepted_evidence.differential_oracle: probe/probe.rs diff mode: for every worksheet of every .xlsx in the tree plus the probe corpus, four legs each from a freshly opened workbook, each producing a visited count plus an FNV-1a digest over the Debug rendering of every (address, cell) pair in production order, or the refusal's Display text
accepted_evidence.tests: three new tests in crates/litchi-xlsx/src/workbook/source.rs streaming_0642_tests, all three also run green against the unmodified base to show they pin preserved behavior
accepted_evidence.code_identity: .text and .rodata section sha256 for every measured binary. The probe was rebuilt after one doc comment was corrected and the rebuild's sections are byte-identical to the measured binary's, with the differential and the warm allocation counts re-run on it; the harness was rebuilt after a cargo fmt whitespace reflow, whose pre-reflow file hash is recorded in the packet README and whose two timing windows straddle the rebuild and agree.

accepted_costs.cold_instructions: a cold whole-sheet read costs +0.186% (visit) and +0.203% (cells) more instructions on the eligible-scan route; per-symbol differencing attributes 852,085 of the 2,907,323 per read (29%) to the new record-validation pass, 13 instructions per record over 65,536, and the remainder to drop-glue and inlining attribution churn from routing both readers through one conversion helper
accepted_costs.cold_peak_unchanged: peak live bytes do not move on a cold whole-sheet read on either route: the peak is set by the worksheet payload plus the scan's record vector, or by the eager parse, before the removed vector is allocated
accepted_costs.instruction_counts: instructions rank work, not latency; callgrind prices rep movsb/rep stosb per byte, so the copy-heavy before leg of the warm walk is over-counted relative to native cycles, and the paired timing is the native check
accepted_costs.inline_always: resolve_selected_record carries #[inline(always)], measured at 688,015 instructions per 65,536-cell read against the out-of-line form on the pinned toolchain; the attribute is a measured decision, not a hint left in by habit

known_gaps.scan_still_materializes: the bounded scan still retains one SelectedRecord per selected cell before publishing; making scan_range yield to the visitor would remove that too but would move refusals after the first visit, which is a contract change needing its own frozen design record and was deliberately not taken
known_gaps.cells_over_allocates: collect_stored_cells keeps the original try_reserve(1) growth loop, which reached a 131,072-slot capacity for 75,770 cells on no_drawing_patriarch, a 42% over-allocation; this change was scoped to leaving cells returning the same vector
known_gaps.cold_timing_unresolved: the cold scenarios sit inside this host's floor, which reached 14.57% at p50 in one window; no cold timing result is claimed
known_gaps.corpus_reach: two corpora, each a single worksheet read whole; nothing is measured for narrow ranges through visit_cells, for the one-cell cell() door, for range-source transports, cold caches, RSS, throughput, other formats or other platforms
known_gaps.probe_corpus_not_harness_corpus: the dense probe corpus follows the harness dense-wide shape (two sheets of 256x256 integers) and is 294 bytes smaller; it is built by the retained probe but is not byte-identical to litchi-xlsx-synthetic-v1
known_gaps.harness_counts_nondeterministic: three callgrind isolation pairs of the identical before harness binary spread 0.34%, so the harness selector's instruction pair bounds rather than measures the work

withheld: any registered speedup, throughput, cold-cache, physical-I/O, range-source, RSS, concurrency-scaling, real-producer or cross-platform result
